newsitem.title: USA: PSC head Hone quits, successors named. [CORRECTED 15:47 GMT]
newsitem.headline: PSC head Hone quits, successors named. [CORRECTED 15:47 GMT]

text.p: PSC Inc said Wednesday that Michael Hone has resigned from his positions as chairman and chief executive because the company has acheived its goals for growth.

Robert Ehrlich, formerly the company's vice chairman, has been elected chairman of the board and Robert Strandberg, executive vice president, will serve as interim president and chief executive, the company said.
Hone recruited Strandberg to PSC in 1996 as executive vice president.

"Now that the foundation has been laid and the strategic direction set, PSC is poised for continued growth that should enhance shareholder value," said Hone. "Rob Strandberg will provide sound leadership for the company at this point. At this stage of my career I look forward to identifying another opportunity to build an entrepreneurial company from the ground up."
PSC said Hone will work with the company on a consulting basis to insure a smooth transition.
